column1: # The fresh twenty, composed 2026-08-29. Replaces the ad-hoc fleet that grew
# one account at a time and ended up 24 characters across five archetypes with
# nobody who fought for a living.
# COMPOSED BY CONSTRUCTION, not by whoever was free, so that every economic
# relationship the project needs actually has both ends present at once:
#   miner_smith  -> ingots            consumed by full_crafter, smith goods
#   lumberjack   -> logs              consumed by full_crafter (spear = 6 ingots + 1 log)
#   alchemist    -> heal potions      consumed by the four fighters (ALCHEMY 15.1,
#                                     so the fighters have no other source)
#   fighters     -> loot              sold; they are the alchemist's customers
#   scribe       -> scrolls           the one proven NPC income on this shard
#   tailor       -> cloth goods       no NPC buyer at all: forces player trade
